data.body: 744b review correction: capable-moist-coot now points to unpushed commit 1de1b4446b98c1955ba44c2ff21d9785fc476529 on parent a46c50e063bb61e5f91e8684c10986f224d74d00. The replay-corpus module docstring was the only post-review correction. It distinguishes removal from the current tree from Git-unreachable pruning, replaces the banned valueogue adjective real with production, and remains strictly smaller than the immutable base at 128 to 50 words. The full five-block oracle, 30 replay-corpus and parity tests, scoped Ruff and format, comment hygiene, diff integrity, make lint, commit hooks, and commit-ticket verification all pass. Full make verify was omitted by instruction. Nothing has been pushed; fresh exact-SHA documentation review is pending.
